## ✨ Highlights

- 🧪 **Pre-releases**: a release can now be published to be tested first - on a lab's nodes, by beta testers - before it becomes the release. It is never an update: no badge, nothing in the fleet's counts, only a folded line on a node's **System › Update** page and on the Controller's update card, installed after typing its version. Once tested, the same build is promoted, unchanged: the nodes running it simply run that release. See [Pre-releases](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/guide/updates.md#pre-releases).
- ⚠️ **Update your Controller to this release** before the first pre-release is out: the Controllers up to v2026.10.11 would take a pre-release for the newest release, and offer it as an update.
- 🖥️ **`janusctl tui` on the [landing page](https://janus.sw-servers.net/)**, a node live in the terminal, next to the Controller's screenshots.

## 🧪 Pre-releases

- **On a node's page**: under the latest release, **Pre-release vX available, for testing**, folded. **Use this pre-release…** asks for its version, typed, then fills the usual A/B installation in, the warning repeated; a node with extensions gets its image built by the image factory first, and the page follows the build. **Rollback** goes back to the release the node ran before; the next release is offered as an update as usual.
- **The Controller's own update**: the same, for an admin, on the update card - typed version, and the update API takes a pre-release only when asked for one (`"prerelease": true`).
- **Marked**: the nodes running a pre-release show **pre-release** beside their version - on the fleet, in a node page's top bar and on its Update page, and in `janusctl tui` (" pre" on the fleet screen, "(pre-release)" on a node's).
- **By version**, like any release: `janusctl lifecycle upgrade`, a Terraform `janus_node`'s `version` (a lab pinned to it, see [Terraform](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/terraform.md)), the Controller's create-a-node form, which suggests it ([hypervisors](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/hypervisors.md)).
- **The image factory** never offers a pre-release as an update; its builder still starts on the newest release and lists the pre-releases, marked, with a warning when one is chosen ([image factory](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/image-factory.md)).
- **janusctl**: apt's new `testing` suite has every release and every pre-release - `https://apt.sw-servers.net/janus testing main` instead of `stable` ([installing janusctl](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/janusctl.md#installing-janusctl)).
- **Not supported**: the [security policy](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/main/SECURITY.md) covers the newest release only. A pre-release publishes no security advisory and doesn't move the docs; both come with its promotion.

## 🖥️ Controller

- **An update is a newer release**: the fleet and the nodes' status compared a node's version with the newest release as text - a node running anything else, newer included, was shown an update to it. Versions are now compared as release versions (CalVer), as the node's page already did.

## 🖥️ The dashboard in the terminal

- **Byte rates fit their columns**: from 100 up, a rate has no decimal (`677KiB/s`) - the servers' IN/S and OUT/S columns cut `676.8KiB/s` short.

## 🌐 Site and docs

- **The landing page** shows `janusctl tui` under "Or from your terminal", and [janusctl](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/janusctl.md#the-dashboard-janusctl-tui) shows it too - made, like the Controller's screenshots, by `make docs-screenshots`.
- [Updates: pre-releases](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/guide/updates.md#pre-releases) - what a pre-release is, installing it, leaving it; [Releasing: pre-releases](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/contributing/releasing.md#pre-releases) - cutting one and promoting it.

## 🔧 Releases

- `image-build.yml` cuts a pre-release (`prerelease`: GitHub's pre-release flag, apt `testing` only, no advisory, no docs), and `release-promote.yml` promotes one without rebuilding it (dry run by default): the flag cleared, the notes read and checked again, then what a release gets - apt `stable`, the docs, the advisories.
- "The previous release" - the security notes' starting point, the docs' `/docs/` channel, the changelog under these notes - is now the newest release on GitHub, never a pre-release's tag.

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- **The Controller**: update it to this release (its Update card, or [by hand](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/dashboard/README.md)) **before installing any pre-release**, on every Controller you run.
- **Nodes**: nothing changed in the node image. Update at your pace, the usual A/B update.
- **janusctl**: `apt update && apt install janusctl`, or the release's `.deb`; switch to the `testing` suite only on a machine that tests pre-releases.
- **The Terraform provider**: nothing changed.
